What We Work On

Not sure what your car needs? Describe the problem when you book and we'll diagnose it before any work starts.

Engine Diagnostic

Check engine light, overheating, knocking, rough running or loss of power. We find the real cause and tell you the price before any work.

Book this service

Fuel System Diagnostic

Poor gas mileage, a fuel smell, hard starts or stalling. We test the fuel system, find the problem and quote it first.

Book this service

NYS Vehicle Inspections

Annual New York State safety and emissions inspections, with repairs handled on the spot.

Tire & Wheel Service

Flats plugged and patched quickly and affordably, plus tire checks, rotations and wheel service.

Exhaust Repair

    Do you offer discounts?

    Yes. Ask about our 25% discount vouchers when you call or book.

    Can you tow my car?

    Yes, we offer towing. Call 315-793-0835 and we'll arrange to get your car to the shop.

    Do you guarantee your work?

    Yes. We stand behind every job: fast, reliable service, 100% guaranteed.

    Who runs the shop?

    J & L is owned by Julio Brito, with 25 years of experience in the automotive industry. Felipe Valentin also handles repair service and can be reached at (929) 476-5106.

    Do I need an appointment?

    Booking ahead guarantees your spot, but call us if you need something looked at today and we'll tell you how soon we can fit you in.

    What payment do you accept?

    All major credit cards.

    Broke down nearby?

    Give us a call before you head over so we can be ready for you.
